# Vision Human Consulting

> Cabinet de conseil et de formation basé à Antibes (Alpes-Maritimes, France). Vision Human Consulting aide les dirigeants, les équipes commerciales et les établissements d'enseignement à relier stratégie, organisation et facteur humain à la performance commerciale. Signature : « Révéler l'invisible. Créer l'impact. » Méthode propriétaire : ODC (Observer, Décoder, Consolider).

Consulting and training firm in Antibes, French Riviera. Founded by Karen Schenck (20+ years in sales strategy, marketing, management and customer experience). Site available in French (default) and English (/en/).

## Key facts

- Legal entity: VEORA REAL ESTATE, EURL, trading as Vision Human Consulting, 1180 chemin des Rastines, 06600 Antibes, France, SIREN 107 361 677

## Consulting offers

- [Notre approche du conseil](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/conseil/): global reading of strategy, organisation, management, sales practices and customer experience before acting
- [Vision · Audit stratégique](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/offres/audit-strategique/): structured audit revealing critical gaps between strategic intent and organisational reality; duration depends on scope
- [Impact · Transformation ciblée](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/offres/transformation-ciblee/): 2-week engagement turning audit findings into concrete, applicable actions
- [Signature · Alignement exécutif durable](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/offres/alignement-executif/): tailored engagement for leadership teams facing governance, organisational or transformation challenges
- [Comparatif des offres](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/offres/)

## Method

- [Méthode ODC](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/methodes/): Observer (see the situation as lived), Décoder (connect findings, separate causes from symptoms), Consolider (prioritised, actionable recommendations with tracking indicators). Cites: +10 to +25% efficiency when people and business strategy are aligned; 4–8% additional growth for people- and customer-centred companies; +5% employee engagement → up to +1.3% customer satisfaction (sources: BCG, Martin Newman, Deloitte, Fujitsu)

## Training

- [Performance commerciale en immobilier neuf](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/formations/immobilier-neuf/): for property developers' sales teams; 1 day, 7h, in-company, on-site or remote
- [Pourquoi votre agence plutôt qu'une autre ?](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/formations/agences-immobilieres/): for real estate agencies; 1 day, 7h, inter- or in-company, on-site or remote
- [Stratégie & performance commerciale](https://visionhumanconsulting.com/formations/enseignement-superieur/): for business/sales/marketing students, BTS to Master's; format built with the institution
